rule: Every statement names the page that shows it and the endpoint that backs it. The platform fetches both.

statements.text: A beat runs on a clock and records itself; the latest beats are listed as data.
Each published entry's source is re-read on the clock, and the share re-read within seven days is served as data with the result for every entry.
Nothing is published here without a cited, graded source; the published list is served as data and says why when it is empty.
Every published entry and each of its sources is a node in one graph, built from the same list.
